title: Human methylarginine sites, v1.2.0 (PTM_Pipeline)
description: The human protein arginine methylation sites of DeAngelo, Silverstein & Shechter, Cell Chem Biol 33:1404-1421 (2026), with the code that builds them and the Methylarginine Site Explorer website. v1.2.0 reads each of 18 studies and databases from its own tables and keeps as a site only an arginine that one of its records passes five site tests for: 11,601 sites on 4,432 proteins, 360 of them placed by the paralog rule and flagged paralog_assigned. The 2,406 arginines that a study reports, or an earlier release had, and that no record passes every test for are kept as lower-confidence sites with their test results. releases/v1.2.0/CHANGES.md says what changed since v1.1.0; v1.1.0 and the published version (v1.0.0) are also included.
